events.factual_description: Shinjuku PIT INN lists YOSHIAKI MASUO GROUP on Monday, October 12, 2026 for 'An 80th Birthday Live Show I Can't Believe Myself!'. Doors are at 19:00 and the performance starts at 19:30. Admission is ¥4,400 including one drink. The announced quartet is Yoshiaki Masuo on guitar, Mikiko Nagatake on piano, Shimpei Ogawa on bass and Kunito Kitai on drums. Doors are at 19:00 and the performance starts at 19:30. Admission is ¥4,400 including one drink. The Izayoi release show matters because improvisation, traditional Japanese vocal material and electronics are being presented as one current ensemble language, not as a crossover garnish.
en.trip_verdict: If October 17 is open in Tokyo, actively make room for Shinjuku and build the evening around PIT INN. It is a strong reason to cross the city for a focused small-room statement; I would fold it into a broader Tokyo stay rather than reshape a wider Kanto itinerary around this one date.
